notes.title: Devlog#19 - New tools & restaurant!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Restaurant Renovators!👩‍🍳[/h3]

Firstly we want to apologize for such a long wait for the updates but now [u][b]WE ARE BACK[/b][/u] with devlogs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/277eb9f9ded045063cec8a64dba5aa7c63c92368.png[/img]

If you've been following the progression of our game development, maybe you remember that last time were working on the procedural visual degeneration of furniture, which we wrote about here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057630/view/3013462968209703038

Today we want to share with you everything we have been working on since that time.

⭐️[b]New restaurant! High-End 5-Star Hotel Restaurant[/b]
 
[previewyoutube=42dxF5Qa_TE;full][/previewyoutube]


⭐️New tool! [b]Window Squeegee[/b] to make windows squeaky clean!
 
[previewyoutube=KraXrFrcc1c;full][/previewyoutube]


⭐️Another new tool! [b]Box of Pesticides[/b] for all of those pesky rats and cockroaches.
 
[previewyoutube=KbZSsLLRFEc;full][/previewyoutube]
